name: Musée des Civilisations Noires
subtitle: A national museum in Dakar covering 14,000 m2 and designed to hold 18,000 pieces, from the first hominids to contemporary art.

parts.text: A national museum in Dakar covering 14,000 m2 and designed to hold 18,000 pieces, from the first hominids to contemporary art. The idea was launched by Senghor in 1966 and the museum was inaugurated in 2018.
